-- go.mod --
module example.com/receiver

go 1.27

-- lib/set.lgo --
package lib

type Set struct {
	Items []int
	Tag   string
}

func (s Set) Bump() { s.Items[0]++ }
func (s Set) Head() []int { return s.Items }
func (s Set) Grow() int {
	s.Items = append(s.Items, 0)
	return len(s.Items)
}

func Sum(items []int) int {
	total := 0
	for _, item := range items {
		total += item
	}
	return total
}

-- bump/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/receiver/lib"

const s = lib.Set{Items: []int{1}}

func main() { s.Bump() }

-- head/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/receiver/lib"

const s = lib.Set{Items: []int{1}}

func main() {
	h := s.Head()
	h[0] = 9
}

-- indexed/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/receiver/lib"

type Rec struct {
	Set lib.Set
}

const records = []Rec{{}, {Set: lib.Set{Items: []int{1}}}}

func bump(i int) { records[i].Set.Bump() }
func main() { bump(1) }

-- nilcase/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/receiver/lib"

const s = lib.Set{Tag: "t"}

func main() {
	if s.Grow() != 1 {
		println("bad")
		return
	}
	println("ok")
}

-- idxcase/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/receiver/lib"

type Rec struct {
	Set lib.Set
}

const records = []Rec{{}, {Set: lib.Set{}}}

func probe(i int) int { return records[i].Set.Grow() }
func main() {
	if probe(0) != 1 || probe(1) != 1 {
		println("bad")
		return
	}
	println("ok")
}

-- localcase/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/receiver/lib"

type plain struct {
	L []int
	N int
}

func (p plain) Total() int { return lib.Sum(p.L) + p.N }

const c = plain{N: 5}

// Red if same-package methods cannot use the value-level exception.
func main() {
	if c.Total() != 5 {
		println("bad")
		return
	}
	println("ok")
}

-- promotedcase/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/receiver/lib"

type Outer struct {
	lib.Set
	Extra []int
}

const o = Outer{Extra: []int{1}}

// Red if an imported promoted method checks the unrelated outer slice.
func main() {
	if o.Grow() != 1 || o.Grow() != 1 {
		println("bad")
		return
	}
	println("ok")
}

-- emptycase/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/receiver/lib"

const empty = []lib.Set{}

// Red if an empty unknown-index candidate set rejects an imported method.
func probe(i int) int { return empty[i].Grow() }

func main() { println("ok") }
